text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I apologize.
I ended up going to bed late last night.
choice_data_list: Days like that happen. You were studying, right?
Days like that happen. You were studying, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was doing a few math workbooks.
Everything was going smoothly up until grading them, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I found an alternative solution listed in the answer key,
and was deciphering it.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Um, I was thinking that if I can come up with an alternative solution at the critical moment, I might be able to break through...
choice_data_list: True, being able to find an alternate solution might be amazing... maybe...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Breakthrough or not, Air Messiah didn't seem to have gotten much rest...
